uncertain: Dashed boss markers 1 and 4 indicate representative cells, not fixed spawns. Targorr the Dread and Kam Deepfury can occupy different cells; the complete Vanilla 1.12 spawn set is not verified. Q1 and Q3 move with those bosses.
Dashed marker 3 indicates a reported Bruegal Ironknuckle location in the first cell on the left when entering the eastern wing. His complete Vanilla spawn set is unverified; he is a rare spawn.
notes: The route clears the entrance hall, then the western wing, then the eastern wing. Variable spawns can change the encounter order.
The prison is drawn with straightened corridors. Angles and distances are not to scale.
Quest markers are offsets connected to their boss loot sources, not separate objects.
Quell the Uprising and The Color of Blood are distributed creature objectives; no fixed quest pickup is asserted.
There are no internal teleporters or separate map-panel transitions.
